tests.name: Playback Bot: smoke
tests.description: Loads apcalc, activates the playback bot panel, verifies the bot instance is reachable and sphere data is parsed. No playback driven.

tests.comment_disabled: Bot stays on _currentRegion=null after rulesLoaded even with stateManager:rawJsonDataLoaded re-emitted from loadRulesFromFile. procgenPlayer must rely on more of the production load flow than just that one event (warehouse build, dispatcher routing of user:regionMove to playbackBot, etc.). Needs deeper investigation into procgen activation under a test-driven load.

tests.description: Drives the bot at instant speed through procgen_maze_worldgen (4 regions, 3 locations) and asserts it reaches the "finished" status.
